selection_rule: Select by count of score2 coherent outputs that also pass the fixed novelty criteria; all16 prompts stay in denominator, including no-output. Tie-break by total coherence score2 count then lower validation NLL. Promote only if joint count improves over previous_late_beam and total score2 count declines by at most2/16; otherwise preserve previous default and expose novelty mode as experimental. Include two predeclared tied-weight regularized GRU models (128/.35/AdamW.01;256/.35/AdamW.01/smoothing.05) in the same comparison before locking. Do not tune after test-prefix evaluation.

coherence_rubric.0: incomplete, ungrammatical, repetitive, or no output
coherence_rubric.1: readable but disconnected, contradictory, generic or missing a responsive punchline
coherence_rubric.2: complete understandable continuation with semantically responsive setup/punchline or internally coherent wordplay

novelty_note: Lexical screening only, not semantic originality or proof of generalization
